title: nanaism/yomiyasu
why_read: A narrow but practical utility that refines AI-generated Japanese text into more natural phrasing, useful mainly for people building or using Japanese-language AI tools.
analysis: This is an 'agent skill' designed to post-process AI-generated Japanese so it reads more naturally to native speakers, addressing a known weakness of LLM output in non-English languages. It's a small, focused tool rather than a research contribution, with value concentrated among Japanese-language NLP practitioners and localization engineers.
